winning_diff:
--- a/fde_capsule/ale_fuel_batch.py
+++ b/fde_capsule/ale_fuel_batch.py
@@ -297,6 +297,12 @@ def _extract_best_code(text: str) -> str:
     import re
     if not text:
         return ""
+    # 剥掉开头(未闭合)fence 行:` ```python` / ` ```py` / ` ``` ` (qwen reasoning
+    # 顶多 142k 思考时偶见开头写 fence 但忘了闭合→judge 把 fence 行当合法码编译假 0)
+    stripped = text.lstrip()
+    if stripped.startswith("```"):
+        first_nl = stripped.find("\n")
+        if first_nl == -1 or "```" not in stripped[first_nl + 1:]:
+            text = stripped[first_nl + 1:] if first_nl != -1 else ""
     py = [b.strip() for b in
           re.findall(r"```(?:python|py)[^\n]*\n(.*?)```", text, re.DOTALL)
           if b.strip()]
